description: One quorum by quorum_id, with every viewpoint and its support. A quorum is one news story split into the distinct viewpoints being expressed about it: each viewpoint has a label, a summary and a support_count of the posts behind it, split into media, socials and iwitness (on-the-ground reports). Costs $0.01; an unknown id is not charged. Needs the Quorumz API key on this connection (Authorization: Bearer <key>); the first 100 calls within 7 days are free.
name: get_quorum
title: Get one quorum
